headlines.text: Back on this day in 2022, Jamie Hayter vs. Hikaru Shida clashed for the AEW Women's World Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 9.12 ? an outstanding performance from both sides. Hayter and Shida delivered what many called the best AEW Women's World Championship match to date, with Hayter's ripcord lariat retaining the title after Shida kicked out of everything thrown at her.

Flash back to 2024, when Claudio Castagnoli chalked up their 100th recorded AEW match ? proof of just how much mileage they've put in, facing Claudio Castagnoli vs. Darby Allin, topping the bill that night on Collision, rated 7.34 ? a strong outing in a hard-fought men's division clash ? part of a stacked Christmas Collision '24 card, rated 8.40 overall.

Turning the clock back to 2024: Mark Briscoe reached a solid half-century of matches: their 50th match in AEW, facing Mark Briscoe vs. The Beast Mortos on Collision, rated 7.12 ? a good, competitive contest in a hard-fought men's division clash, on an outstanding Christmas Collision '24 show that earned an overall rating of 8.40.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2022, when Colten Gunn was back in action after 6 weeks away, appearing on Dynamite.

Rewind to 2024, when Daniel Garcia vs. Shelton Benjamin met in a Continental Classic League Match on Collision, rated 7.06 ? a solid showing, on an outstanding Christmas Collision '24 show that earned an overall rating of 8.40.
